stops.note: citizen, giving rise to civilis (of citizens, civil)
formed from civil for bringing a society out of a primitive state
stops.meaning: to bring a society out of a primitive state

stops.note: settled as the English word for bringing a society to a more advanced, ordered state
stops.meaning: to bring a society to a more advanced, ordered social state

current_meaning: to bring a society or people to a more advanced, socially ordered state
